blocks.heading: Your information
paragraphs: This website is operated by IncubXperts TechnoConsulting Private Limited. We collect only the information you choose to give us, for example through our contact form (name, email, organisation and message).
We use this information to respond to your enquiry and to manage our business relationship with you. We do not sell your personal information.
You can ask us to access, correct or delete your information at any time by writing to engage@incubxperts.com.
We may use privacy-friendly analytics to understand how the site is used. If cookies are added in future, this policy and a consent banner will be updated accordingly.
